summary: Iter37 backend regression + new coverage for Phase 3f route extraction (Projects/VA/PM/Owner). All 9 prior test files (98 tests, 1 pre-existing skip) remain green AND new test_iter37_*.py adds 10 tests covering the gaps called out in the request: full VA-Commission lifecycle (booked → paid → pm_approved → owner_approved → paid), double-pay guard, owner-approve-requires-pm-approved, mark-paid-requires-owner-approved, Owner permission gate (admin without is_owner → 403 on all /owner/* routes — parametrized × 5), and projects worker-view PII gating (crew_visible flips False→True once the requesting worker is accepted on a project gig). verified_features: [REGRESSION] All 9 prior pytest files still green after Projects/VA/PM/Owner extraction — 98 prior tests pass, 1 pre-existing skip (no behavior change).

[Import wiring] One session: POST /api/auth/login → 200, GET /api/projects → 200, GET /api/pm/leads → 200, GET /api/owner/dashboard → 200, GET /api/va/dashboard → 403 (expected — owner has role=admin not va; require_va correctly rejects). No 500s anywhere.

[VA lifecycle] booked → calculating commission; paid → pending_approval; PM approve → pm_approved; Owner approve → owner_approved; Owner mark-paid → paid; amount is correct ($25 flat for 'deep'); VA /va/dashboard.total_paid reflects the payment.
[Double-pay guard] Second POST /api/owner/payouts/{id}/mark-paid on a paid commission returns 400 with 'already' + 'paid' in detail (HTTPException raised by owner.owner_mark_paid).
[Order guards] POST /owner/payouts/{id}/approve requires current status == pm_approved (else 400). POST /owner/payouts/{id}/mark-paid requires current status == owner_approved (else 400).

[Owner permission gate] Mechie (admin, is_program_manager=true, is_owner=false) gets 403 on GET /owner/dashboard, GET /owner/payouts/queue, POST /owner/payouts/{id}/approve, POST /owner/payouts/bulk-approve, POST /owner/payouts/{id}/mark-paid. Owner (is_owner=true) gets 200 on /owner/dashboard with all expected keys (payout_queue_count/amount, month_total_commissions, top_by_volume, alerts).

[Projects worker-view PII] Two fresh workers; admin assigns worker A to a project-linked gig via POST /api/gigs/{id}/assign. Worker B (outsider) hits /api/projects/{id}/worker-view → 200, crew_visible=False, no 'crew' arrays leaked in linked_gigs. Worker A (approved) hits same endpoint → crew_visible=True. Title + linked_gigs structure visible to both.
[VA self-referral guard] still returns 400 'Self-referral blocked' when prospect_address normalizes to VA's va_address (covered by existing test_va_commission.py).
[VA duplicate-lead guard] still returns 409 with detail.code='duplicate_lead' inside the 90-day window (covered by existing test_va_commission.py).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/owner.py mark-paid double-pay branch returns 400. Consider returning 409 (Conflict) since the resource state forbids the action — more idiomatic REST. Not blocking; current message is clear.

routes/pm.py pm_update_lead_stage allows direct stage='paid' without ever passing through 'booked'. _ensure_commission_for_lead handles the missing prior commission by creating it, so behavior is fine, but a stricter state-machine (must transition booked→completed→paid) would prevent accidental skips. Out of scope for this refactor.

routes/va.py va_create_lead address normalization compares stripped-lowercased strings; a VA could trivially bypass self-referral by appending an apartment number to the prospect address. Existing helper _normalize_address only strips punctuation/whitespace. Consider extracting just the numeric+street fragment for the check. Not a regression introduced by Phase 3f.

routes/projects.py worker-view: when there are no gigs linked, the response sets crew_visible=False — but the request shape always includes 'description' (empty string fallback) while the gig-present branch never explicitly sets 'description'. Minor inconsistency only; not failing any test.

va_commission._ensure_commission_for_lead treats already-frozen statuses ('approved','paid','owner_approved') as terminal and short-circuits — but 'pm_approved' is NOT in that frozen list, so re-transitioning a lead from paid → completed → paid would overwrite a pm_approved commission's amount/calc_notes. Recommend adding 'pm_approved' to the frozen set. Not exercised by current UI/tests.
server.py still 1,534 lines after Phase 3f. Profile/auth helpers and lifespan/startup logic are reasonable next-extraction candidates.
